verdict.rationale: Trello has a documented public REST API. First-party guides cover generating an API key, delegated auth via the 1/authorize route or OAuth1.0, and configurable token scopes and expiry, and the REST reference lists Batch, Search and Webhooks. Trello also advertises an MCP server for connecting AI tools. Probes found no llms.txt, no markdown docs and no OpenAPI spec at the candidate paths, which weakens machine-readable discoverability for agents. missing for 10: a discoverable OpenAPI/machine-readable spec or llms.txt, detailed evidence of endpoint coverage beyond section names, independent or hands-on corroboration of API use.
